comment: The Ministry endorses this section. The distinction drawn at lines 793–809 between governed structure and governed meaning, and the analysis at lines 822–827 of how uncoordinated extension of an exchange standard produces "interoperable silos", match Slovenia's national experience closely. The observation at lines 828–830 that aligning information models at the outset improves interoperability regardless of the underlying exchange or persistence technology is, in our view, the most important sentence in the chapter. We would encourage the drafting team to give this material greater prominence, as set out in our comments on Chapter 2.
